verdict.rationale: Nix's own documented operations act on many items at once. The garbage collector deletes all unused packages in one run, a whole system configuration can be built or rolled back as a unit, and a fleet of servers can be described in a single repeatable configuration. However, the evidence never frames these as a general bulk-operation feature, and none of it is specific to AI agent use. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk command interface for selecting arbitrary sets of items, documented upgrade-all or multi-target CLI examples, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows driven by an AI agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
